reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: This is the WORST app I’ve ever used when it comes to journal/mental health apps. They’ll rope you into a “trial” that charges you $40 for a year long membership to an app that essentially has no features unless you’re paying for the $100 tier. I tried to get a refund immediately when I saw the charge and have been denied. $40 for an app I used one time and don’t even have on my phone anymore. The AI features made me uncomfortable … you’re sharing your private thoughts with an AI bot. No thank you! Don’t make the mistake I did by ever downloading this app. I opened the app one time and got scammed out of $40!! WARNING!!!

reviews.title: Worth every penny!
reviews.text:
I’ve used stoic for almost 2.5 years. Before stoic, I tried using other journaling apps (Grid Diary & Day One, to name a couple), but always found it hard to stick with the habit. Stoic is very customizable and adjusts to how I want to use the app in different seasons of my life (sometimes I want to do one reflection in the morning and one at night, other times I only have enough mental bandwidth to get through one, and there are days that I just do a mood-check). I don’t feel pressured to journal “the right way”, which makes it easier to stick with the habit and be mindful for at least a few minutes per day. 
The team is CONSTANTLY working on improving the app with new features and taking care of bugs. Stoic might be the only company I’ve interacted with in the past couple of years that truly listens to user feedback and works to make a product better rather than just making a profit. Their customer service is TOP TIER.

reviews.title: Inconsistent, Deleting/Not Saving Entries, MacBook App Not Working
reviews.text: When the app works, it’s great. It is literally a daily need for me, and has been for years. Lately, and for a few months now, my entries will not save, or will only partially save. I lose WAY TOO MUCH. On top of that, stoic has been running smoothly on my iPhone, but when it comes to my MacBook, it’s useless. I can pretty much only type an empty page journal. I am completely unable to do my daily check in. The Home page doesn’t even show anything. All of these flaws are extremely annoying, and are making the app unusable.
